recipes.name: Snacks' Crazy Sweet Corn Pudding
ingredients_raw: 1 (8.5 ounce) package dry corn muffin mix

steps.text: Preheat an oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Lightly grease a baking dish.

Beat the margarine and sugar with an electric mixer in a large bowl until light and fluffy. The mixture should be noticeably lighter in color. Add the room-temperature eggs one at a time, allowing each egg to blend into the butter mixture before adding the next. Beat in the sour cream, vanilla, nutmeg, cinnamon, and cloves. Pour in the corn muffin mix alternately with the milk, mixing until just incorporated. Fold in the cream-style corn and sweet corn; mixing just enough to evenly combine. Pour the batter into prepared pan.
Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean, 45 minutes to 1 hour. Cool in the pans for 10 minutes before removing to cool completely on a wire rack.

raw_recipe.headline: Snacks' Crazy Sweet Corn Pudding
raw_recipe.description: Loaded with whole corn kernels, this sweet and savory side dish will have holiday guests begging for more! Cornbread never tasted so good!

review.reviewBody:
This is a delicious way to get children to eat CORN!!! I made this a while ago and was a bit shocked that it wasn't the usual type of corn pudding. Since I love corn bread, it's like another version of it. DELICIOUS!
I had to double it though because I always cook for over 15 people.
This was fabulous! I made it into muffins by skipping the milk and cream of corn. The seasoning and moisture was fabulous. I put it in the oven at 375 for 11 minutes.

All in all, this was a nice change from a traditional corn side dish, especially for a Christmas meal. I was going to serve sweet potatoes sweetened with brown sugar along with the ham, but was concerned this dish would make for too much sweetness on the table, so be aware of this possibility. I followed someone’s advice on cutting back on the allspice, but next time I think I’ll add the full amount. Also, I think this would taste better warm, not cooled off as suggested. I warmed up a slice the next morning and added some maple syrup on top for a tasty addition to my breakfast. With a little work, this would make a great holiday breakfast dish.

This was the best cornbread pudding I have ever had. We started eating it before thanksgiving dinner was served. I made a few adjustments to mine. I added a little more sugar, used one less egg, I didn’t use any cloves. I also added extra spices and I add some pumpkin spice as well. I am having some for breakfast this morning. Thank you so much. I am glad I am only making this on special occasions, because it is too good to resist.

Recipe easy. Made many additions/changes because I like it a certain way. I use brown sugar instead of white (because it deepens the color) and added more than stated. Used more vanilla Nutmeg allspice than it calls for. Baking now and smells awesome. Let's see how it taste. Update to follow.
This was a delicious side dish. Served with Italian Beef. Yum.

I made this exactly like instructions. It was a huge hit at Christmas dinner tonight. The taste and smell were amazing. This dish was requested for next year before the meal was finished. Thank you for the recipe!!
The entire family loved it! I sprinkled cinnamon sugar on top for a little crunch!
I added a little more cinnamon and a dash of ginger to mine. It was ever so tasty!

Super easy to make. The house smells amazing and the dish is so tasty. I followed the recipe exactly and it came out great. No need to make any changes or worry about taste or consistency. I was nervous about the amount of cloves but it wasn’t overpowering at all!!! Highly recommended!!! This ones going to make the holiday list from now on.

The flavor was ok, nothing amazing. The texture, however, I had problems with. After reading the previous review and seeing that this was supposed to be turned out onto a wire rack to finish cooling I was expecting more of a cornbread consistency, but I got something in between a pudding and a bread. Definitely too loose to dump out onto a wire rack even though the toothpick came out clean when tested in several spots after baking for the full hour. Will definitely not make again.
My friends and I liked it, it was good.
